text:
marcus: Quick partner sync / SDK v3 breaking change (auth header rename -> x-rw-auth, payload key input -> user_prompt). Need partner timeline + marketplace gating.

olivia: propose conservative plan:
- w0 partner heads-up
- w2 publish SDKs + migration guide (py/js/go)
- w4 private canaries (3 partners: 1 marketplace, 1 HW OEM, 1 SI)
- w6 soft-deprecate (Deprecation header on v2)
- w10 hard-deprecate

sam: SI note 1: many integrators ship monthly installers. suggest 3-month shim grace for binary bundlers and a documented rollback.

lee: legal will draft a 1-paragraph Marketplace T&C addendum and an OEM attestation for embedded runtimes. also confirm SLA implications.

nina: infra ask 1 perf delta for top-3 models across GPUs + quant levels before canaries. sam can you own perf runs?

sam: yes. will produce perf matrix by w1.

marcus: ops: schedule 72h dedicated support for canary window and 48h after soft-deprecate. olivia to coordinate oncall.

deploy-bot: FYI marketplace listing reviews can take up to 21 days; blackout Sundays 02:00-06:00 UTC. advise partners to submit updates >=21 days before planned launch.

olivia: docs: add migration snippet and a tiny CLI test harness; sample curl in guide. will draft partner emails (marketplace vs integrators) and post by Fri.

marcus: checklist owners add one-line status by EOD Wed so I can publish partner calendar. if partners sign early, we can shorten canary window.
